explication: Statue is a Markdown-first static-site generator built around SvelteKit and reusable Svelte components. A site author adds Markdown content and config; the CMS exposes content-query operations used by template routes, which present pages using template components. The product also documents built-in search, blog/docs layouts, themes, and template choices. The tree and excerpts establish some CMS-to-route calls, but not the full render or build pipeline; those links are shown only where documented, and unsampled subsystems use their existing directories as paths.
